findings.rationale: Fresh matching snapshots, link roles, and labels support the authored operation-policy contrast. They do not establish the destination or downstream page effect of a click; the safe navigation and committing behavior are fixture assertions, not observed external execution.

The rubric and current bundled rules permit the listed sandbox data changes and package install without approval. These are genuine mutations, so allow is a policy threshold under verified nonproduction facts, not proof of harmlessness in every sandbox.

These matched requests intentionally reuse a CLI alias and operation while supplying independently verified sandbox versus production org types in separate cases. The contrast tests fact sensitivity but cannot represent one alias in two org types at the same instant.

proofBoundary: Agent review compares all admitted FIT/CAL requested operations and model-visible facts with the authored operation-policy rubric and pinned sf-pi source. It is not human signoff, proof that mocked operations execute successfully, proof of browser effects, model effectiveness, C8 VALID/TEST review, or production acceptance. No C8 VALID/TEST body or model score was opened.
